text: Stonefield Distribution, a $200M industrial parts distributor with three regional warehouses, is migrating off an old on-premise ERP onto Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
Today the month-end close takes weeks, and even after it closes, nobody trusts the department-level numbers that come out of it.
Elena Marchetti, the CFO, sponsors this project -- she wants a fast close and real department visibility into cash, payables, and receivables.
Three warehouses already act as real cost centers in the business, but the legacy ERP has no clean way to represent that.
Next: turning 'clean financials from day one' into one precise, testable requirement.
